# About this site

Pharmacolibrary collects pharmacokinetic, pharmacodynamic and pharmacogenomic models from the published literature and makes them runnable.

## How to cite

Kulhanek, T., Jezek, F., Kofránek, J., Mateják, M., & Rommes, S. (2025, October). Pharmacolibrary-Free Library to Model Pharmacology. In *Modelica Conferences* (pp. 61-72). [https://doi.org/10.3384/ecp21861](https://doi.org/10.3384/ecp21861)

## How the knowledge base is made

Literature is retrieved from PubMed and available full-text sources. Extraction follows *relevance assessment → screening → localisation → transcription → interpretation → validation*, then a model is built and its simulation compared with the paper's reported values. Parameter estimates keep the paper's labels and units.

## Record status

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| **Curated (human-checked)** | Authored or checked by a person against the paper. |
| **Reproduces paper** | The model built from the extracted parameters reproduces the paper's reported reference values; not human-verified. |
| **Reproduces with caveats** | Reproduces the paper's reference values, but an advisory check is open (for example, covariate scenarios not evaluated). |
| **Simulated** | The model runs for this record's scenarios and each one changes the simulation, but the paper reports no values for them to compare with. Not a verdict. |
| **Not simulated** | Extracted and checked against closed-form rules, but no simulation has compared it with the paper yet. Not a verdict. |
| **Needs review** | Incomplete, inconsistent or implausible extraction, or a failed replication; the values are unverified. |
| **Rejected** | Not accepted; the values are shown for inspection only. |

Counts on this page and in the sidebar are record counts, not trust counts; each card names what it counts.

Records a curator should look at are listed in the [curator queue](/review/).
